headline: Hohem's tiny steadycam has a removable action cam
summary: Hohem's new Eyepic steadycam features a unique removable action camera. It aims to compete with DJI Osmo Pocket and Insta360 devices. The design includes a rotating preview screen for versatile shooting.

headline: How Sonos rebooted itself
summary: Sonos CEO Tom Conrad discusses the company's recent challenges and redesign efforts. Conrad, formerly of Pandora and Snap, joined Sonos during a "disastrous 2024 app" period. The interview explores Sonos' future, including AI and smart home integration.

headline: SwitchBot's retrofit door lock offers 19 ways to unlock it
summary: SwitchBot launched a new retrofit smart lock at IFA. The Lock Ultra Max Vision Pro Combo provides up to 19 unlocking methods. Features include fingerprint, passcodes, NFC, and facial recognition for European homes.

headline: DJI's new robovac can climb obstacles, vacuum quietly, and claims much improved privacy
summary: DJI introduced the Romo 2 series, its second-generation robovac. The new model boasts quieter operation, enhanced power, and improved obstacle climbing. A significant privacy update includes a new local-only data mode.

headline: Ghost of Yotei is Getting a Roguelike Survival Mode That Includes Ghost of Tsushima's Jin
summary: Ghost of Yotei will receive a new single-player roguelike survival mode. Titled "Most Wanted," it's part of the upcoming Complete Edition. The mode will feature Jin from Ghost of Tsushima.

headline: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Just Dropped a Major Connection to The Next Generation (Not That It Makes Much Sense)
summary: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds made a significant connection to The Next Generation. The plot point, however, is noted to be inconsistent or illogical. This connection may surprise or frustrate TNG fans.

headline: Save Big During Men's Wearhouse's Labor Day Sale With BOGO 50% Off
summary: Men's Wearhouse is holding a Labor Day Sale. Customers can enjoy a Buy One, Get One 50% Off promotion. The sale covers various categories of their extensive inventory.

headline: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Recap and Review - The Worst Episode of the Season Still Manages to Give Pike Some of His Best Scenes Ever
summary: Episode 7 of Strange New Worlds Season 4 is reviewed as the season's weakest. Despite its flaws, the episode provides some of Captain Pike's best scenes. The review highlights the show's unfulfilled potential.

headline: Andy Burnham praises UK-EU ties in meeting with Emmanuel Macron
summary: Andy Burnham met with Emmanuel Macron in Downing Street for bilateral talks. Discussions focused on small boats, defense, and the conflict in Ukraine. Burnham expressed praise for UK-EU relations during his first such meeting.

headline: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
summary: A BBC investigation reveals a shortage of small boats for Channel crossings. Rival criminal groups are now forced to collaborate. Smugglers are using larger "mega-dinghies" due to supply limitations.

headline: Watch: BBC witnesses 'taxi boat' picking up migrants multiple times in a day
summary: A BBC investigation observed a "taxi boat" repeatedly transporting migrants. Smuggling gangs face a shortage of small boats, leading to collaboration. Larger boats are being used to transport more migrants per trip.

headline: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
summary: Renowned feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem has passed away. She died peacefully at her New York City home at 92. Steinem was surrounded by loved ones at the time of her passing.
